reviews.text: Excellent staff, Dr. Robertson genuinely cares about his patients, and they aren't corporate controlled.  I drive an hour to get my dogs (5) and cats cared for by Dr. Robertson because he listens and discusses the treatment plan with me

I called Midway Veterinary to schedule an appointment, and the process was very easy and straightforward. I was also able to speak with the doctor about my concerns, and they took the time to listen and provide their professional expertise and guidance. I really appreciated the helpful and caring service.

The team are very insightful and make you feel comfortable of the situation. Very attentive team and shout out the receptionist, she is very kind and tries to work me in during urgent visits. Glad I came across this place and hope the culture remains the same. Meowy and Tuco send their regards 🐾🐈🐈‍⬛
All of our pets (1 dog, 2 cats) are patients at Midway. I would not hesitate to recommend this clinic to anyone looking for top notch veterinary care.

Called to try to make a first vet appointment for my dog. The lady was extremely rude. Didn't seem like she wanted to help me or establish me as a new client. Was really excited to try this clinic out after reading reviews, but I guess I got the wrong representative. Disappointing.

Well, I have a favorite hairdresser here and she is fantastic, Ashley.
Problem is, the Front Desk never answers the phone so two months ago it took 10 days to return my call & by that time I had gone elsewhere, this month I actually had to drive up here because no one answered the phone or returned my call when I left a message.
Good way to lose business.

This is our daughter’a vet.  We were babysitting while she was out of town. Her dog hurt his paw to where he couldn’t put any weight on it.  They made time to see him on busy day.  Thankfully no broken bones.  Mikko is healed and back to his playful self.  Thanks to Dr Roberts and staff for showing compassion to all their patients.

After searching for a veterinarian for several years, I finally found an amazing one! Everyone—from the front desk staff to the vet techs and the doctor—made me feel like I'd been coming there forever.

Raymond and Jameson were especially kind and caring with both me and my pet. The veterinary care was excellent, everything was explained clearly, and the prices were beyond fair. I couldn't be happier and highly recommend this clinic!
Dr Roberts and his staff are top-notch. Love the care they give to all of our animals. They're professional and thorough without trying to overcharge on every visit. Fantastic service all around

This review is not about Midway Road Animal Clinic, but about it’s RUDE receptionist.
I walked in to ask about walk in appointments for my dog who was lethargic. The receptionist with eyeglasses to the right as you walk in, said with a condescending attitude, we don't accept walk-ins, have a good day. She was not sympathetic to my needs at all. To you Miss rude and condescending lady, you should be nicer to people because you never know what someone is going through. She’s literally the worst and should not be doing customer service at all!!! I would not recommend this place.  I ended up going to Banfield hospital where I was taken care of without the ATTITUDE of this lady.

We tried a few different vets before coming here and we have had the best experience at Midway Road Animal Clinic! Everyone is so kind and you can tell they really like their jobs and working together. They don’t over do things here which I really appreciate! We are so happy to find our vet home! ❤️
Great pricing and quick visit

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to Dr. Roberts and his team for taking such amazing care of my cat until the end. When all other vets seem to have given up on him, Dr. Roberts persevere. Eventhough he passed away shortly after surgery, I am super grateful for their care and was able to spend a few more months with my baby boy. Despite my almost weekly vet visits, he only perform procedures that were necessary, and was mindful of potential financial strains. Of the 10+ veterinary clinics that I've visited, him and his team are the most kind, considerate, and knowledgeable in the DFW area.
These folks are aces! The vet will answer all of your questions, not have one foot out the door to head to another patient. Can't recommend him highly enough
Best in the area. 28 year customer.

I would like to thank Dr. Robert’s and the staff for the care that they provided for our dog Ollie. We had to say goodbye today after 15 years of love and affection. The people at Midway Road Animal Clinic are so kind and caring that I could not recommend a better place to take your fur babies. Thanks again.
Stan & Ellen Baker
A genuinely brilliant vet. I can't recommend highly enough.
I’ve had only great experiences with this vet clinic. They are so kind and reasonably priced.
Dr Roberts is the best! Guinness loves him! Highly recommend!
Great pricing, friendly staff, I feel like they care. We drive all the way from Arlington to get our 3 dogs looked at. I hope they never change
Amazing local vet!

Caring vet that actually spends time with your pet. Vet techs are knowledgable, kind, and loving to the animals. Reasonable pricing and they don't treat caring for your pet as a sales process. Wouldn't take my animals anywhere else.
Everyone was super friendly and caring! Price was fair as well

Update: I’ve been using Dr. Roberts and Midway Road for close to a decade now.  Excellent veterinary care, willingness to answer questions and talk through things without talking down to you, lower costs than other places we’ve taken our dogs to, and such a warm, welcoming group of people who clearly care about animals.  My wife and I have used a smattering of vets all over the area for various reasons, but we’ve wound up consolidating all of our dogs at Midway Road for a reason.

This is the best vet. Very reasonable cost, great people, easy to work with, and great veterinary care.  There's a reason everyone in this part of town takes their pets here.  We've recently converted some family members that live in other parts of the city who previously had a less friendly, more money grubbing vet.  It's worth the trip for them to get good care, a warm environment, and not get ripped off.

Affordable, caring, and efficient:

- My cat, Tita, had a rash and some hot spots. They didn't charge me an arm and a leg to treat her, and what they gave her started to clear her up the very next day.

Thank you!
Always good
Best vet in town. We’ve been going to them for 11yrs. We moved to another town and switched vets because of the distance but had to come back to them. They really do care for their patients
Great staff and doctors.  This vet clinic has a lot to live up to because of the retired gentleman who began the clinic and Dr. Robert's and all his staff do a beautiful job at it.
Always friendly and helpful
Top notch. These guys are a well oiled machine team - Dr. Roberts ans his crew. They work well with each other and so well with the animals. Dr. Roberts was born to do this.
It's the best clinic for my pets and the prices are very reasonable, but the best thing is the love with which they treat the pets!!! ❤️🐶 …
The most compassionate and amazing staff!  Words can't express how grateful our family is! Will recommend y'all to everyone! Five stars across the board ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My dog had been struggling with a flea allergy and he had been scratching so much his fur would fall. Nothing would work and I came here in hopes they’d help. They were so gentle and kind with my dog and also very communicative! They’re very budget-friendly and professional. It’s been a few weeks since I visited and my dog’s fur has completely grown back!

Jasper loves these guys
Fantastic vets!
Gig'em
Great service. ♥️

Dr. Stephens was our elderly dog Rusty's vet for his last few years. During that time he treated Rusty with kindness and gave him top-notch care. He helped ease Rusty's pain, particularly as he struggled during his last days. Finally, Dr. Stephens helped us say our last goodbyes to our sweet boy.  It could not have gone more smoothly.

My sweet dog, Lexi was put to rest today.  This clinic did an amazing job handling the procedure, preparing us and just being wonderful, compassionate people.  I have been coming here for 10 years since we moved to Dallas.  I think they are #1!!!  Thank you Midway Road Animal Clinic!!!
Excellent vet, excellent staff, and very fair pricing. Would not go anywhere else
